about: The named moves a plate brief may give a still. Drawn from config/ve/brand-tokens.json motion (slide, drop, slap; nothing moves for its own sake; ambient drift 1.5%) and config/ve/tools.json (Runway and Higgsfield: short motion of an approved still only, never cinematic, never type, numbers, logos or a mouth). An engine move costs nothing; a generated move needs Krish's yes per generation and is logged with ve ledger.

still_drift.what: the approved still holds with the house ambient drift (1.5%)

slide.what: the still slides in on the beat's first event with the slide token (12 frames), then drifts

parallax.what: the still is separated into two or three layers that drift at different rates

push_in.what: one slow push toward the subject of an approved still, one shot
push_in.made_by: Runway or Higgsfield from the approved still
push_in.spend: Krish's yes per generation; ve ledger <piece> add credits <n>

default.rule: hook and payoff beats of 5 s or less take push_in; every other plate takes still_drift. A brief may name another move by beat.
